nodes.label: Design System: VoM website (getvom.com)
nodes.rationale: Saudi cloud accounting presented as an official record being issued, Arabic first and mirrored in English; records the shipped system, including drift, rather than intentions.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: The Official Record (الوثيقة)
nodes.rationale: Every page is a document VoM issues to the visitor: white paper ground, authority as one unbroken teal field engraved with guilloche, paper objects with the precision of a government form (double hairlines, double-ring seals, serials, tabular numerals, bilingual lines).

nodes.label: One Signature Idea per Page
nodes.rationale: The system is restrained by rule: each page gets one signature idea and one orchestrated motion on load with a reduced-motion fallback; the rest of the page stays quiet around it.

nodes.label: Reading Register
nodes.rationale: Introduced by the terms page: the same world at its quietest, no field, no guilloche, no buttons, teal only as a marker, for long documents.

nodes.label: Ledger Page (blog register)
nodes.rationale: The reading register ruled as a ledger: white sheet on Cool Paper split by one 2px Record Teal rule into a numbered margin and a wide column; its one idea is the ruling.

nodes.label: Guilloche (engraved lattice on teal fields)
nodes.rationale: The lattice of certificates and banknotes, drawn white at 10 to 14% opacity, signals authority.

nodes.label: Slanted Teal Field Edge (clip-path cut)
nodes.rationale: Fields are not rounded; they are cut with a slanted edge and the slant is mirrored for LTR.

nodes.label: Arabic RTL First, Mirrored for LTR
nodes.rationale: Layout is built right-to-left first; slanted field edges, transforms and arrows flip for English.

nodes.label: Pinned Brand Palette
nodes.rationale: Teal, orange and near-black on cool paper, extended only with tints and shades of those hues.

nodes.label: Marker Teal (teal-600)
nodes.rationale: Used as the field on the campaign panel, ZATCA Phase 2 field and VoM Pay lead field because white text reaches about 3.8:1 against 2.4:1 on Record Teal.

nodes.label: Mist (ink-300)
nodes.rationale: Below AA as text (about 2.6:1 on paper); list markers and bilingual micro-labels only.

nodes.label: Reading Ink (86% ink)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately softer than Record Ink for long legal reading; a register difference, not drift.

nodes.label: The One Hot Colour Rule
nodes.rationale: Orange marks the single action to take or the single 'now'; never a background field, heading colour or decoration.

nodes.label: The Guilloche-on-Teal Rule
nodes.rationale: Guilloche drawn white at 10-14% on teal fields only; never on paper, paper objects, seals or the reading register; a reading surface gets at most one field.

nodes.label: The Book-in-Slate Rule
nodes.rationale: On a textbook spread the textbook page is printed in Slate and Graphite on Cool Paper with no teal; teal and the double hairline belong to the facing VoM page.

nodes.label: The Paper-or-Record Rule
nodes.rationale: What a visitor takes away is the paper side (Slate on Cool Paper, no teal); whatever leads into VoM carries teal; orange stays on the sign-up alone.

nodes.label: The Ledger-Page Rule
nodes.rationale: A blog page is one ruled sheet with a single 2px Record Teal rule between a 3/12 margin and 9/12 column; no teal field, guilloche or orange before the closing band.

nodes.label: The White-on-Teal Rule (open conflict)
nodes.rationale: Owner decision that text on teal bands is white; measures about 2.4:1 on Record Teal, below the AA floor in CLAUDE.md, recorded as an open conflict rather than a validated pairing.

nodes.label: White-on-Orange Open Conflict
nodes.rationale: White text on Action Orange measures about 2.7:1, below AA; applies to the site-wide primary pill and lead form submits, awaiting the owner's ruling.

nodes.label: Effra (single typeface for Arabic and Latin)
nodes.rationale: A single humanist sans covering Arabic, Latin and digits so both locales share one voice; hierarchy from weight and size, not a second family.

nodes.label: The Effra Only Rule
nodes.rationale: One family loaded through next/font/local in weights 300, 400, 500, 700; no second face and no third-party font link.

nodes.label: The Tabular Figure Rule
nodes.rationale: Every comparable number (amounts, serials, dates, counts, clause numbers) is tabular and set dir=ltr inside Arabic text.

nodes.label: The One Card Rule
nodes.rationale: A guide's identity lives on its index card, never in a line above its title; no eyebrow or kicker over any heading.

nodes.label: The Riyal Sign Rule
nodes.rationale: Amounts carry the official SAMA riyal sign as a CSS mask before the figure in a dir=ltr no-wrap span, currency word visually hidden; never 'SAR' or an image tag.

nodes.label: Display Type Ramp (and fluid Display steps)
1280px Page Container with 16px Gutter
nodes.rationale: Asymmetric composition: hero and closing sections split 7/12 to 5/12 with copy on the start side and field or object on the end side.

nodes.label: Observed Drift (recorded, not repaired)
nodes.rationale: Deviations from the rules and ramps are recorded per surface so they are visible for owner decisions, not silently fixed.

nodes.label: Shadow Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Depth is tonal first; shadows are long, soft and negatively spread so objects read as lifted paper rather than cards.

nodes.label: The Teal Shadow Rule
nodes.rationale: Shadows are tinted with Shadow Teal, never neutral grey, and belong to paper documents, overlays and hover states; sections, tiles and frames at rest stay flat.

nodes.label: Document Frame (double hairline)
nodes.rationale: Lines carry authority: a 1px teal-200 border with a second hairline 4px inside it frames every paper object VoM issues.

nodes.label: Mega Menu (disclosure)
nodes.rationale: A disclosure, not an ARIA menu: button with aria-expanded, Escape returns focus to the trigger.

nodes.label: Partner Mark (optical scale)
nodes.rationale: Each wordmark is drawn at a context height times its own optical scale so no partner outweighs another.

nodes.label: The Honest Stamp Rule
nodes.rationale: A «بلا حد» stamp marks one entry that is unlimited, never a total, heading or section; plan-dependent entries also carry the plan marker.

nodes.label: Template Sheet
nodes.rationale: The one paper object in a single hairline, because it is a print you take away, not a document VoM issues.

nodes.label: Calculator Fields (inputs, slider, choice pills, two-way switch)
Campaign Root Layout
nodes.rationale: A paid-campaign page is its own document with no site header, navigation or footer, so the page's one action is its form.

nodes.label: Lead Form Sheet
nodes.rationale: Invalid fields are marked by doubling the edge in ink, with no red and no orange, so orange stays on the submit alone.
